title: Token tax: LLM token premiums for 200 languages relative to English (FLORES-200)
description:
Token premiums for the 200 languages of FLORES-200 (204 rows: a few languages in two scripts) on the tokenizers behind ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Meta's Llama, DeepSeek, Qwen and Mistral: tokens(language) ÷ tokens(English) for the same text, the FLORES-200 devtest sentences, following Petrov et al. (2023). Swedish needs 35 % more tokens than English on ChatGPT, Santali 1 273 % more.

The data (data/data.csv per language, data/country_premiums.csv per country, data/tokenizers.csv describing each tokenizer) and the scripts that reproduce it. The FLORES-200 text itself is not included; the scripts download it. Interactive globe: https://sara.moricz.se/token-tax/
